implementation: Independent Numba-compiled implementation of the frozen rhs and RK4 equations; Qn incidence matrices constructed from oriented cubical cells. Equations and frequency-frame convention matched to models/q6_topological_synchronization.py.

Independent Numba-compiled implementation of the frozen rhs and RK4 equations; Qn incidence matrices constructed from oriented cubical cells. Equations and frequency-frame convention matched to models/q6_topological_synchronization.py. A direct RHS cross-check against the equations gives maximum absolute component error below 9e-16 for both models.

T1.interpretation: Only the origin fixed point was verified as stable. The 200 random starts did not converge; this is not evidence that a second stable fixed point does not exist. T1 bistability criterion is not passed.

T3.metric: mean over seeds of |R0_forward-R0_backward| at each sigma; forward ascending sweep, reverse sweep initialized from forward terminal state
T3.interpretation: NLT passes the dwell-persistence criterion in this three-point local sigma window; NL fails it. This is a local-window pilot, not the complete 41-point sweep.
NLT passes the dwell-persistence criterion in this three-point local sigma window; NL fails it. This is a local-window pilot, not the complete 41-point sweep.

T4.interpretation: NLT clears the 0.50 size threshold at sigma=1.20 and 1.25 but not 1.30. NL fails at all three tested points. T4 remains local-window and dwell-640 only.

comparisons: RK4 dt=0.025 vs DOP853 rtol=1e-10 atol=1e-12

blockers: T1 did not verify a second stable fixed point; random Newton multistart failed to converge.
T2 used a coarse 9-point sigma scan, not the full preregistered 0.05 grid.
T3 used only sigma=1.20,1.25,1.30; the full 41-point sweep remains outstanding.
T4 used only dwell=640 and the same three-point sigma window.
Robustness was checked only at sigma=1.25, not across the full preregistered sigma subset.
scientific_conclusion: The current pilot supports a strong, persistent NLT initial-family separation near sigma=1.25, with NL failing the corresponding T2/T3/T4 local checks. It does not yet establish two stable fixed points or bistability. No Lyapunov function, effective potential, barrier, tunnelling or wormhole interpretation follows from these data.
